scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap shows Tak Ye-jin crying alone at the playground after confronting Ra Joon-mo, asking Baek Seung-chan why he always catches her right after an accident.

scenes.title: You Look Cooler When You Are Feisty
scenes.summary: When Seung-chan awkwardly shields crying Ye-jin from passersby at the playground, his oddball kindness dries her tears and she thanks him for staying by her side.

scenes.title: I Am Dropping the Honorific Suffix From Now On
scenes.summary: Ye-jin catches Seung-chan calling her plain seonbae without the honorific suffix -nim, and Seung-chan boldly declares he will drop the extra honorific from now on.

scenes.title: I Am Going to Sleep at the Office
scenes.summary: While Joon-mo boasts that soothing angry Ye-jin is the easiest thing in the world—if only she came home—Ye-jin refuses to enter his apartment and heads back to KBS to sleep.

scenes.title: If You Want This Bag Safe, Come Home in Thirty Minutes
scenes.summary: Joon-mo texts a photo holding scissors over Ye-jin's prized handbag to lure her home within thirty minutes, then sincerely apologizes for lying to her.

scenes.title: Rumors Must Be Nipped in the Bud
scenes.summary: Visiting Cindy's hospital room before discharge, CEO Byun insists Cindy fly overseas immediately to quash tabloid rumors, while Cindy quietly notes she no longer has a mother or home she misses.

scenes.title: Sending a Girl in a Cast to an Event?
scenes.summary: Seung-chan gives Ye-jin a ride to the hospital to get her stitches out, where Cindy's sympathetic road manager turns around mid-sentence to discover Cindy has vanished.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's apartment parking lot and hospital

scenes.title: Have None of You Ever Gone Off the Grid?
scenes.summary: Disguised Cindy climbs uninvited into Seung-chan's car at the hospital to go off the grid, using Seung-chan's dread of extra parking fees to get them rolling out of the lot.
scenes.location: hospital parking lot and Seung-chan's car

scenes.title: You Called CEO Byun Third-Rate?!
scenes.summary: Ye-jin confesses she is secretly terrified of CEO Byun despite acting tough, then gasps in disbelief when Seung-chan reveals he once called Byun third-rate to her face.

scenes.title: No Money, Busy Friends, and an Injured Leg
scenes.summary: Cindy asks to be dropped at a taxi stand despite having no cash, nowhere to hide, and no close friends to call, softly reminding Ye-jin that her leg still hurts.

scenes.title: I Would Rather Walk Into a Lion's Den
scenes.summary: Terrified of telling CEO Byun he lost Cindy, Cindy's road manager goes into hiding himself, and a furious CEO Byun orders her staff to comb every place Cindy could go.

scenes.title: I Will Impose on You for Just Three Days
scenes.summary: After ruling out Seung-chan's gossipy middle-school sister and Seoul's luxury hotels where CEO Byun is already looking, Cindy asks Ye-jin to let her rest for just three days.

scenes.title: Airport Photographers All Got Stood Up
scenes.summary: At the 2 Days & 1 Night meeting, Ji-yeon reports Cindy skipped her overseas flight and left airport reporters empty-handed, making guilty Seung-chan fumble while Joon-mo doubts Cindy has anywhere to hide.

scenes.title: A Temporary Address-Sharing Relationship
scenes.summary: Having brought Cindy to Joon-mo's apartment, Ye-jin fumes when Cindy calls it cohabiting with Joon-mo, insisting they are merely temporary address-sharers—just like Cindy now.

scenes.title: At a Luxury Hotel in Paris With a Chaebol Heir?
scenes.summary: Ji-yeon and Tae-ho spin a wild theory that Cindy defied CEO Byun and skipped her schedule because she is dating a chaebol heir in Paris, while Seung-chan mutters that they know nothing.

scenes.title: All We Have in This House Is Tangerines
scenes.summary: Settling Cindy into her pink-wallpapered bedroom with a prized hemp pillow, Ye-jin bristles at leopard-print jokes and snaps that their home only has tangerines when Cindy asks for lime water.
scenes.location: Ye-jin's bedroom and kitchen in Joon-mo's apartment

scenes.title: I Am Capable of Keeping a Poker Face
scenes.summary: After scheduling an evening amusement-park scout with Joon-mo, Seung-chan recalls Ye-jin warning him not to tell Joon-mo at work—and fails to tip Joon-mo off before Joon-mo leaves for drinks.

scenes.title: All I Need Is Feta Cheese, Lentils, and Quinoa
scenes.summary: Perfectionist Cindy refolds the apartment's towels to crisp angles, Seung-chan delivers limes for her water, and Cindy requests feta cheese, lentils, and quinoa for dinner.

scenes.title: Report Her Missing So Everyone Knows Cindy Vanished?!
scenes.summary: Chief Manager Kim warns CEO Byun that rumor X-files are spreading and suggests calling the police in case Cindy was kidnapped, earning an explosive rebuke from Byun.

scenes.title: This Guy Is Writing Fiction Again!
scenes.summary: Over barbecue, Tae-ho and a colleague gossip about Cindy being spotted in Paris before the colleague pivots to conspiracy theories about the admin clerk's luxury wardrobe.

scenes.title: Is My Apartment a Public Meeting Plaza?!
scenes.summary: Returning home to find Seung-chan setting the table and runaway Cindy sitting inside, Joon-mo asks why Ye-jin plays the saint with his apartment and groans that everyone makes him look like the bad guy.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's apartment kitchen and living room

scenes.title: Are You Planning to Stay Tomorrow Too?!
scenes.summary: While rumors place Cindy at a Paris luxury hotel, she happily wraps rice in seaweed at Joon-mo's table, praises Ye-jin's spicy stew, and politely asks them to stock superfoods for tomorrow.

scenes.title: The Bird Breaks Out of the Egg
scenes.summary: Curious about the underlined lines in Seung-chan's novel, Cindy reads the famous passage about a bird breaking out of its shell, and Seung-chan explains that true freedom and growth require breaking stagnant bounds.

scenes.title: I Will Speak Frankly: Our Cindy Went Into Hiding
scenes.summary: When CEO Byun unexpectedly shows up outside Joon-mo's building, Cindy offers to leave, Joon-mo goes out to meet Byun, and Byun candidly confesses Cindy has gone AWOL.

scenes.title: Nobody Can Beat Rumors and Whispers
scenes.summary: Veteran CEO Byun warns Joon-mo that nothing is deadlier than unverified 'maybe' rumors, asking him to tell reporters Cindy is resting safely—which Joon-mo agrees to since Cindy truly is resting well.

scenes.title: Of Course! Are You Challenging Me Right Now?
scenes.summary: Relieved CEO Byun suspected nothing, Joon-mo admires Cindy's spotless organizing—including sorted takeout chopsticks—and kicks off the 'Of Course!' game over beers until Cindy challenges Ye-jin.

scenes.title: You Know That Is Why I Like You, Right?
scenes.summary: In the 'Of Course!' game, Cindy rattles Ye-jin by guessing she gets dumped inside three months, and Joon-mo steps in to tell Ye-jin she is prettier and cuter than she thinks.

scenes.title: Preparing the Breach-of-Contract Penalty Files
scenes.summary: Searching Cindy's empty apartment for clues, CEO Byun instructs her manager to call Lawyer Hwang in the morning and prepare penalty-fee documentation for every missed schedule.

scenes.title: I Debuted at Thirteen—Sixty in Idol Years!
scenes.summary: Taking her first real drink with Joon-mo and Seung-chan, Cindy reveals an adorable tipsy habit of repeating over and over that she debuted at age thirteen.

scenes.title: My First Home-Cooked Birthday Meal in Ten Years
scenes.summary: At breakfast the next morning, Cindy quietly shares that today is her birthday and her first home-cooked birthday meal in ten years, then begs wide-eyed to join Joon-mo's night trip to the amusement park.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's apartment patio and dining table

scenes.title: You Always Put What You Really Mean After 'Meanwhile'
scenes.summary: CEO Byun plants a press story slipping in 'female producer T-PD' after 'Meanwhile,' sparking an 85% fan poll against Ye-jin and graffiti all over Ye-jin's car.
scenes.location: agency office, Music Bank office, and KBS parking lot

scenes.title: CEO Byun Deflected the Arrows Straight at Ye-jin!
scenes.summary: As angry protest calls flood KBS, Director Jang hedges that an article built on mere nuance is hard to sue over, and Joon-mo realizes CEO Byun deflected all public blame onto Ye-jin.

scenes.title: The Phone Number Stuck Inside Your Windshield!
scenes.summary: Putting on a brave face despite hate texts flooding her phone, Ye-jin learns from Seung-chan that fans copied her number off her windshield parking card—before Seung-chan yanks her back from a passing motorbike.

scenes.title: Call It Method Acting—Please Be Careful, Senior
scenes.summary: When a burly silhouette approaches Ye-jin in a dim garage, Seung-chan steps in front of her speaking casually like a boyfriend—turning out to face a friendly former manager—and warns her to take the threats seriously.

scenes.title: A Recycling Prodigy at the Apartment Complex
scenes.summary: Sorting recyclables outside Joon-mo's building, Cindy dazzles the neighborhood women's association with rinsed bottles and peeled labels before spotting a tabloid headline about herself.

scenes.title: Watch Your Mouth in the Elevator
scenes.summary: Caught gossiping about admin clerk Go Yang-mi's luxury lifestyle again, a fellow producer gets cornered in the elevator and warned never to spread stories about her again.

scenes.title: My First Pleasure Outing in Ten Years
scenes.summary: After enjoying a peaceful phone-free day offline, Cindy receives birthday wishes from Seung-chan and arrives at the night amusement park disguised in a cap and wheelchair.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's car and amusement park entrance

scenes.title: Are You Not Embarrassed in Front of Your Own Muscles?
scenes.summary: After paying to scrub the graffiti off her car and removing her windshield phone card just as Seung-chan advised, Ye-jin joins Joon-mo at the park and mocks his trembling hands after a spinning ride.
scenes.location: auto repair shop and amusement park rides

scenes.title: People Will Remember Their Brightest Days Alongside Your Songs
scenes.summary: At the spot where she was street-cast ten years ago, Cindy fears she only has downhill left at twenty-three, and Seung-chan tells her that a star lives on forever in listeners' brightest memories.
scenes.location: illuminated amusement park plaza at night

scenes.title: Now Whenever I Think of Amusement Parks, I Will Think of You
scenes.summary: Cindy confesses ten sleepless years of blaming herself for the accident that took her parents after her birthday trip, and after Seung-chan gently absolves her, she thanks him for a new memory.

scenes.title: How Did That Caller Know My Phone Number?
scenes.summary: In the epilogue, after stepping outside because someone phoned to say her car headlights were left on, Ye-jin suddenly wonders how that caller knew her number once she removed her windshield card.
